description: This file defines interfaces and components related to ADB (Android Debug Bridge) configuration within the Cuttlefish project. It includes enum definitions, abstract classes, and component factory functions for dependency injection.

classes.name: AdbConfig
classes.description: Abstract interface for ADB configuration, providing methods to get and set modes and run connector status.

classes.name: AdbConfigFragment
classes.description: A configuration fragment class related to ADB, inherits from ConfigFragment.

classes.name: AdbConfigFlag
classes.description: A feature flag class for ADB configuration, inherits from FlagFeature.

methods.name: StringToAdbMode
methods.description: Converts a string to an AdbMode enum value.

methods.name: AdbModeToString
methods.description: Converts an AdbMode enum value to its string representation.

calls: fruit::Component<fruit::Required<KernelLogPipeProvider, const AdbConfig, const CuttlefishConfig, const CuttlefishConfig::InstanceSpecific>>
